Numeric, R0 ~ 1/(1e11 GeV): gamma = 5.1e26 and 1-v = 1.9e-54 at R = 1 m. lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested for this result: what the tree uses is post-nucleation bubble dynamics (wall -> c, energy into the wall, interior masses differ). Re-derived here, these depend on no measured datum: they hold for every eps > 0, sigma > 0 and h_inside != v (rederive (1),(2)), so no datum the 2018 authors lacked can move them. The data-dependent part is whether the vacuum is metastable at all (top mass, alpha_s, Planck-scale operators), which the source takes as its premise and the tree takes from 1307.3536; the tree's case split makes C4 independent of it (z3-valid). What would move the tree's USE is not data but the bridging premise H-BRIDGE: evidence against it would be a source computing that the bubble interior forms bound atoms of ordinary mass at the nucleation site, which nothing read here shows; evidence for it (the CDL interior crunch) is NAMED-NOT-READ.
